# Marimo Studio 0.2.2

Marimo Studio 0.2.2 lets notebook hosts embed Studio editors and run notebooks
before their first view exists, and launches editors that follow file edits.

## Run Studio inside notebook hosts

- A host script in marimo's server-level `html_head` can declare its parent
  with `data-parent-origin`. Studio adds that origin to the framing policy of
  the workspace, its embedded native editor, and the native documents served at
  edit `/`.
- `marimo run` serves the notebook as a marimo app while its view root contains
  no view, and the server logs a warning naming the notebook.
  `marimo-studio status` reports `needs-view` for that notebook.

## Authoring updates

- Launch commands printed by `view create`, the CLI help, and the agent
  instructions include `--watch`, so edits from a coding agent or another
  editor reload in the Studio editor and Preview.
- Slider thumbs reach both ends of their track.
- CLI help, errors, and documentation name the **Python**, **Browser**, and
  **Prepared** runtimes the way the Studio UI shows them. The `server`, `wasm`,
  and `zero-python` option values stay the same.
- The PyPI project page shows the Studio lockup, the example wall, and the
  commands to run and export a view.

## Compatibility

Marimo Studio 0.2.2 supports Python 3.10 through 3.14 and
[Marimo](https://marimo.io/) 0.25.0. The `deno` extra provides
[Deno](https://docs.deno.com/) 2.9.5 or newer for [React](https://react.dev/),
[Reveal.js](https://revealjs.com/), [Svelte](https://svelte.dev/), and
[Observable Notebook Kit](https://observablehq.com/notebook-kit/kit) authoring.
The `lens` extra requires
[marimo-lens](https://github.com/marimo-team/marimo-lens) 0.2.2 or newer.
